Title: Sample Preparation
Instruction: Lyse cells in RIPA buffer with protease inhibitors. Incubate on ice for 30 minutes, vortex every 10 minutes.
Notes: Keep samples on ice at all times

Title: Protein Quantification
Instruction: Measure protein concentration using BCA assay. Prepare BSA standards from 0-2 mg/mL.

Title: Sample Denaturation
Instruction: Add 4x loading buffer. Heat at 95°C for 5 minutes.

Title: Gel Electrophoresis
Instruction: Load 20 ug protein per lane on 10% SDS-PAGE gel. Run at 120V for 90 minutes.
Reagent_2_Unit: Include molecular weight marker in lane 1

Title: Transfer
Instruction: Transfer to PVDF membrane at 100V for 60 minutes in cold transfer buffer.
Notes: Pre-wet PVDF in methanol for 30 seconds

Title: Blocking
Instruction: Block membrane in 5% non-fat milk in TBST for 1 hour at room temperature.

Title: Primary Antibody
Instruction: Incubate with anti-p53 (DO-1) at 1:1000 in 5% milk/TBST overnight at 4°C.

Title: Wash
Instruction: Wash 3x with TBST for 10 minutes each.

Title: Secondary Antibody
Instruction: Incubate with HRP-conjugated anti-mouse IgG at 1:5000 for 1 hour.

Title: Final Wash
Instruction: Wash 3x with TBST for 10 minutes each.

Title: Detection
Instruction: Develop with ECL substrate. Image immediately.
